episodes.synopsis: An unexpected encounter with an old friend in Virbank City presents our heroes with unexpected challenges galore!
episodes.title: All for the Love of Meloetta!

episodes.synopsis: With Cynthia's help, our heroes have begun training for the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, and a couple of old friends come along for the wild ride!
episodes.title: Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes take a break from special training, a mysterious island offers much more than they bargained for!
episodes.title: Expedition to Onix Island!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes train for the upcoming Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, a worried neighbor of Cynthia's comes by for help!
episodes.title: The Mystery of the Missing Cubchoo!

episodes.synopsis: While our heroes continue preparations for the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, a sudden emergency and a Pokémon in need change their lives forever!
episodes.title: Iris and the Rogue Dragonite!

episodes.synopsis: The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup is off to a roaring start, while our heroes are faced with rivals old and new!
episodes.title: Jostling for the Junior Cup! (1)

episodes.synopsis: The second round of the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup is off and running, while a battle between the winner and Alder waits in the wings!
episodes.title: Battling Authority Once Again! (2)

episodes.synopsis: The exciting Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup continues, and the semi-finals and finals hang in the balance of the results of these last two matches!
episodes.title: Ash, Iris, and Trip: Then There Were Three! (3)

episodes.synopsis: The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup may be winding down, but new adventures are just beginning!
episodes.title: Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure! (4)

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes' new friend Cameron needs to win his eighth Gym badge in order to enter the Unova League, and that sets the stage for an unforgettable adventure!
episodes.title: The Road to Humilau!

episodes.synopsis: While Ash trains for entry into the Unova League, our heroes discover a Pokémon nursery that urgently needs their help!
episodes.title: Unrest at the Nursery!

episodes.synopsis: A sinister plot to take over the Unova region is taking shape, and our heroes are caught in the middle of it!
episodes.title: Meloetta and the Undersea Temple!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket's "Operation Tempest" is under way with a fierce vengeance, and the fate of the Unova region hangs in the balance!
episodes.title: Unova's Survival Crisis!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the site of the upcoming Unova League, our heroes take on an unexpectedly messy battle challenge!
episodes.title: Beauties Battling for Pride and Prestige!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue their trek to Vertress City and the Unova League, they're challenged to a Tag Battle the likes of which they've never experienced!
episodes.title: A Surface to Air Tag Battle Team!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are visiting the Village of Dragons on their way to Vertress City, where Iris is confronted with several life-changing challenges!
episodes.title: A Village Homecoming!

episodes.synopsis: As Iris takes on her battle challenge issued by the Opelucid City Gym Leader Drayden, little does she know what's truly in store!
episodes.title: Drayden Versus Iris: Past, Present, and Future!

episodes.synopsis: Traveling to Vertress City and the Unova League, our heroes are introduced to a brave family on a mission of service!
episodes.title: Team Eevee and the Pokémon Rescue Squad!

episodes.synopsis: The Unova League is off and running, old friends and rivals are reuniting, and the battle action is unrelenting!
episodes.title: Curtain Up, Unova League!

episodes.synopsis: As the battle excitement in Vertress City builds to a fever pitch, the Unova League pairs friends and rivals, old and new!
episodes.title: Mission: Defeat Your Rival!

episodes.synopsis: While the Unova League prepares to move to the third round, our heroes are faced with a case of lost and found!
episodes.title: Lost at the League!

episodes.synopsis: As the Unova League makes its way through the third round and barrels toward the quarterfinals, strategy and friendship lead the way!
episodes.title: Strong Strategy Steals the Show!

episodes.synopsis: It's the fourth round of the Unova League, and Cameron's "secret weapon" turns out to be more than anyone thought, including Cameron!
episodes.title: Cameron's Secret Weapon!

episodes.synopsis: As the Unova League roars toward the final match, the competition becomes more fierce, and the strength and skill levels more amazing!
episodes.title: A Unova League Evolution!
